description: This file defines the ProjectRepository class in a PHP project. It provides methods for interacting with project data in a MySQL database, including CRUD operations, searching, cloning projects, and checking visibility to users. The class extends MysqlRepository and uses several external classes for SQL building, models, and pagination handling.

classes.name: ProjectRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing Project data in the database, including CRUD operations, search, clone, and visibility checks.

methods.name: isVisibleToUser
methods.description: Checks if a project is visible to a specific user based on visibility settings and user association.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves project details by project ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for projects based on given criteria and optional pagination.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of an existing project and associated tasks, assigning it to a user.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new project record into the database.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a project record by ID with specified new values.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds and returns the base SELECT query builder for project queries.
